nom: Philosophy The Microdelivery Triple-Acid Brightening Peel

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with self-described sensitive skin mostly report no irritation with weekly use, but several reviewers, including some who explicitly say they do not have sensitive skin, describe a sudden burning, bright-red reaction within minutes of a first application.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who describes dry, sensitive skin reports no irritation and a steady improvement in discoloration with weekly use.
segments.oily: The one reviewer who describes oily skin says it helped balance her skin and clear acne without drying it out.
segments.combination: The reviewer with combination skin says the peel balanced her skin and gave it a glow she doesn't usually get from dewy or glow-focused products.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s through 70s consistently credit the peel with brighter, smoother skin, fewer visible fine lines, and faded age or sun spots, with several saying it remains a permanent weekly step well into their 50s, 60s, and even 70s.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s report smoother skin, softened fine lines, and reduced wrinkles with regular weekly use; one long-time user in her late 30s notes that as she's gotten older, scarring from breakouts takes longer to fade, and the peel helps speed that fading.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently say the peel does not dry out or strip their skin, several noting it leaves skin soft and glowing rather than tight, and one adds that a moisturizer can follow if needed but isn't required.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation, and one says her chronic facial redness visibly faded, but several others, including two who explicitly say they do not have sensitive skin, describe a sudden burning and bright-red reaction within minutes of first use that took over an hour to fade.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report fading of dark spots, sun spots, melasma, or acne scars with regular weekly use, though several are careful to note the peel fades rather than fully erases discoloration, and one still had visible sun spots after six uses.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some with hormonal or adult acne, report fewer breakouts and faster fading of post-breakout marks, but one reviewer found red bumps had appeared on her forehead the morning after her first use, and another says she still gets occasional blemishes despite regular use.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who mentions oily skin says the peel helped control it and cleared her acne without leaving her skin dry.

aspects.libelle: Strong scent that fades after drying
Pad generously saturated for multiple areas
Can leave a tacky or shiny finish

extraits.titre: Be very careful if you have sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I used this as directed on clean skin after showering, and after two minutes looked like I had a horrible sunburn on my face and neck! I washed it off twice with cold water and still look ridiculous an hour later. Do not use this product if you are fair or light complected! This has never happened to me before with any cosmetic product I've used; exfoliatiors, peels, masks, you name it.

I would not purchase this product!! I do not have sensitive skin and within a few minutes after using one pad my whole face turned completely red! It looks like i got a really bad reaction. I do not recommend product. I tried washing my face with cold water but the red has not faded.

I ordered this product because I suddenly remembered what success I had when using it several years ago. It works gently to rid the user of discolorations/dark spots. I find I don't need to use this product every night. A few nights a week usually is enough for me to have noticeable improvement. I use this product at bed time to help avoid sun exposure. My skin is a bit sensitive when using this product. The smell is not pleasant, but it goes away after the product dries. If it didn't work so well, I don't think I could tolerate the scent or price. I have adult acne-prone dark skin that is given to hyperpigmentation. I experience noborritation when using this product. I would repurchase and recommend.

I love this product. I bought this product when it was on sale and have only used it once every other week because of how strong but also privey it is. I have melanated skin and this left my skin feeling slightly tacky but the GLOW that I got from this product was insane. I have combination skin so i normally dont care for dewy/ glow products but this really helped to balance my skin and give me a nice glow. I cant say it helped with hyperpigmentation because I was not able to use this past two months due to the price.

I've been using these once a week as recommended for a few years now and would not be without them. 30 seconds each week is all it takes and my skin is soft and smooth. I'm in my late 30's going into 40 soon and still experience the occasional hormonal breakouts. I find that as you age, it takes longer for any scarring to fade after a breakout. These peel pads truly help keep the skin bright and help fade these dark post-breakout marks over time for me. My skin is sensitive but I have no issues at all with these pads causing any irritation. I use these in the PM 1x per week and I follow with the renewed hope moisturizer. The pads are of a very generous size and saturated, so you'll even have enough for the back of your hands and elbows! I made the mistake of not reordering these in time. My skin really felt the difference and looked dull for the couple of weeks I went without, so I will not be without them again. Philosophy: please do not discontinue these...Please!

extraits.titre: A splurge that became a necessity
extraits.texte: This was not an easy purchase for me to make. I have a very hard time buying things for myself but I decided I wanted to give this product a try because my other philosophy products have done amazing things for my skin. I will never be without these pads. I have discoloration from the sun and old acne. I noticed a difference in my skin tone after just one use and it continues to get better each week! I look forward to using this product every Friday. I have dry, sensitive skin and have had no irritation from these. I just swipe the pad on my face and follow up with moisturizer. I need less foundation and concealer every week.
Cleared up my acne, brightens, evens tone, and seems to help with oily skin without making it dry. I use it every other day, it is amazing.
